scale: reduced-local BSM design: 158-continuous first-order candidate design (the 2 binary scenario switches are excluded from the candidate set, as in production), n_outputs=40, n_runs=2000, B=199, B_screen=199, fwer_reps=100, alt_reps=20 — deliberate reduction from the executed ~30 000-run / 23 495-output HPC scale. Preserves empirical input ranges and the 158-continuous first-order structure, multivariate low-rank responses (PCA path), hierarchical residualized interaction discovery, and train-only selection. Candidate-family logic (BH screening -> fwer_max_stat_exact selection at α=0.05) unchanged.

scenarios.name: global_null
scenarios.description: Complete global null: no main, interaction, or transform signal.

scenarios.name: interaction_null
scenarios.description: Continuous main effects and a nonlinear main-effect transform, but no true interactions.

scenarios.name: sparse_strong_hierarchical
scenarios.description: Sparse strong-signal hierarchical model: continuous main effects + a continuous-continuous interaction + a transformation term.

scenarios.name: weak_signal
scenarios.description: Same hierarchical support as sparse_strong but low signal-to-noise.

scenarios.name: correlated_redundant
scenarios.description: Dense active set with many candidate pairs (redundant active and inactive predictors) stressing selection precision.

scenarios.name: pure_interaction

scenarios.name: nonlinear_misspecified
